svg.text: Made for harness testing: 95 trials instead of 330, about 15% of the cost. 22 of 26 leaderboard entries land within 5 points of their full score.
Sorted hard → easy by pass rate across all 26 leaderboard entries
Cost = typical cost of the task relative to an average Terminal-Bench 4.0 task.
Runs on Hugging Face Jobs: single container, fits 8 vCPU / 32 GB
No GPU tasks, and no tasks that drew safety refusals on the leaderboard
Dropped candidates with known faulty instructions or forged-result bugs
Spread from hard to easy, across 7 domains
Every public leaderboard entry (26 model / effort combinations)
22 of 26 entries land within 5 points; the gap column is highlighted where they don't.
Good enough to compare harnesses and catch regressions — not a substitute for a full leaderboard run.
Source: public Terminal-Bench 4.0 leaderboard, every trial of every entry (5 attempts per task). 26 of 27 entries used; Opus 5 / max excluded (trial records don't match its published score).
The subset is scored from those same trials. Compared only with the other 47 tasks (no shared trials), the average gap is 4.6 points and rank agreement 0.90.
Against 20,000 random 19-task picks from the 48 tasks meeting the same constraints, this subset is closer than 94% and cheaper than 99% of them.
Caveats: chosen with this leaderboard in view, so expect it to be a little less accurate for new models. Pass rates and costs come from the leaderboard's agents and models.
Several subset tasks have open verifier-hardening issues in the Terminal-Bench v4.1 milestone; pinned to the v4.0 task digests the leaderboard ran.
